per_category.int8_note: dynamic INT8 quantizes only Linear layers; EfficientAd is conv-dominated so this does NOT meaningfully accelerate it (measured on CPU). Static INT8 of the student-teacher conv stack needs a custom calibrated qconfig + fused conv-bn (not done); FP16 is the recommended edge precision.
